english.title: Unacceptable behaviour on Transport for London road transport premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) whilst upon Transport for London road transport premises

(A)_[used threatening, abusive, obscene or offensive language]_
(B)_[behaved in a disorderly, indecent or offensive manner]_
(C)_[wrote, drew or painted on the premises]_
(D)_[fixed an item, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ITEM..), to the premises]_
(E)_[soiled the premises]_
(F)_[damaged a part of the premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY DAMAGED..)]_
(G)_[detached a part of the premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY DETACHED..)]_
(H)_[spat]_
(I)_[left litter or waste]_
(J)_[molested or wilfully interfered with the comfort or convenience of another person on the premises]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6 and 14 of the Transport for London Road Transport Premises Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
whilst upon the Transport for London road transport premises
used threatening/abusive/obscene/offensive language OR
behaved in disorderly/indecent/offensive manner OR
wrote/drew/painted on the premises OR
fixed an item to the premises OR
soiled the premises OR
damaged a part of the premises OR
detached a part of the premises OR
spat OR
left litter/waste OR
molested/wilfully interfered with the comfort/convenience of another

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 13 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 15 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 16 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
(iv) See Byelaw 17 in relation to the provision of notices.
